product: Branded consumer goods. Home and Outdoor (OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey) and Beauty and Wellness (Braun, Vicks, Honeywell, PUR, Revlon, Drybar, Curlsmith, Olive and June). New demand is innovation and distribution led: OXO pet care launched 2026-08-03; Hydro Flask and Universal Music Group partnership launched 2026-06-01 (stocktitan; stockanalysis transcript 2026-07-08).
demand: Mostly price plus distribution, with soft units. On 2026-04-23 the CFO said about $50M of FY27 revenue comes from price increases with effectively 100% of planned increases in place. Q1 FY27 sales rose 8.2% but included $4-5M of Prime Day order pull-forward while core beauty point-of-sale stayed soft (stockanalysis transcripts).
pricing_power: Tariffs and input-cost inflation. Q1 FY27 gross margin fell 110bps to 46.0% and the CFO expects Q1 to be the worst FY27 compression; higher commodity, freight and Chinese-yuan costs more than offset the about $9.2M phase-I tariff refund (2026-07-08). FY26 also showed promotional intensity and inventory-obsolescence risk (2026-04-23).
market_strategy: 2026-04-23 CEO Scott Uzzell promised to be 'a better company on the road to being a bigger company' via a three-phase FY27-FY31 roadmap. CFO Brian Grass set FY27 sales $1.751-1.822B, adjusted EPS $3.25-3.75, FCF $85-100M, net leverage about 3.2x or lower, China-tariff COGS below 20% and about 55% dual-sourcing by FY27 end (stockanalysis transcript).
bull: Q1 FY27 sales rose 8.2% to $402.1M and FY27 sales guidance was raised to $1.759-1.831B; debt fell to $716.1M and net leverage to 3.48x from 3.87x (2026-07-08 transcript).
bear: Q1 gross margin fell 110bps to 46.0%; CFO sees Q1 as worst compression, with commodity, freight and yuan costs exceeding the $9.2M tariff refund, and ~80% of FY27 EPS back-half weighted (2026-07-08).
falsifier: The 2026-10-08 Q2 FY27 report: H1 adjusted EPS not near 20% of the $3.25-3.75 guide, or Q2 gross margin falling beyond the guided tariff path.

web_what_changed_30_90d: 30d: 2026-09-17 Q2 FY27 earnings set for 2026-10-08 (stocktitan). 2026-08-25 AGM re-elected nine directors and approved +965000 stock plan shares (SEC 8-K 2026-08-26, primary). 90d: 2026-07-08 Q1 FY27 sales rose 8.2% to $402.1M, gross margin fell 110bps to 46.0%, and FY27 sales guidance was raised to $1.759-1.831B (stockanalysis transcript).
web_true_now_not_modelled: On 2026-07-08 CFO Brian Grass excluded tariff-refund upside from guidance: $71M of IEEPA tariffs paid, only about $9.2M phase-I refund booked, and refunds would exceed expected inflation if fully collected. He also guided only ~20% of FY27 adjusted EPS in H1 and ~15% in Q2, so earnings are H2-weighted (stockanalysis transcript).
web_demand_product: Branded consumer goods. Home and Outdoor (OXO, Hydro Flask, Osprey) and Beauty and Wellness (Braun, Vicks, Honeywell, PUR, Revlon, Drybar, Curlsmith, Olive and June). New demand is innovation and distribution led: OXO pet care launched 2026-08-03; Hydro Flask and Universal Music Group partnership launched 2026-06-01 (stocktitan; stockanalysis transcript 2026-07-08).
web_price_volume_mix: Mostly price plus distribution, with soft units. On 2026-04-23 the CFO said about $50M of FY27 revenue comes from price increases with effectively 100% of planned increases in place. Q1 FY27 sales rose 8.2% but included $4-5M of Prime Day order pull-forward while core beauty point-of-sale stayed soft (stockanalysis transcripts).
web_bottleneck: Supply chain. On 2026-07-08 the CFO cited two or three pinch points of potential supply scarcity and cost inflation from the Middle East conflict, covering commodity inputs, inbound and outbound freight and Chinese-yuan pressure, exceeding the $9.2M tariff-refund benefit. Internally, demand-planning and advanced-planning systems are still being built (2026-07-08 transcript).
web_who_benefits_next: Retailers gaining from HELE distribution: Walmart for OXO, DICK'S Sporting Goods and Target for Hydro Flask, plus Amazon e-commerce, per 2026-07-08 call. Universal Music Group benefits from the 2026-06-01 Hydro Flask partnership; Southeast Asia suppliers gain from dual-sourcing (2026-04-23). Third-order beneficiaries not found.
web_who_loses: Not found as an explicit statement. On 2026-07-08 the company said it is reducing exposure to lower-margin channels, improving marketplace dynamics and addressing third-party sellers, implying third-party resellers and low-margin closeout channels lose, while discretionary category rivals lose share to Braun, Osprey and OXO (2026-07-08 transcript).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Tariffs and input-cost inflation. Q1 FY27 gross margin fell 110bps to 46.0% and the CFO expects Q1 to be the worst FY27 compression; higher commodity, freight and Chinese-yuan costs more than offset the about $9.2M phase-I tariff refund (2026-07-08). FY26 also showed promotional intensity and inventory-obsolescence risk (2026-04-23).
web_ceo_promised: 2026-04-23 CEO Scott Uzzell promised to be 'a better company on the road to being a bigger company' via a three-phase FY27-FY31 roadmap. CFO Brian Grass set FY27 sales $1.751-1.822B, adjusted EPS $3.25-3.75, FCF $85-100M, net leverage about 3.2x or lower, China-tariff COGS below 20% and about 55% dual-sourcing by FY27 end (stockanalysis transcript).
web_did_they_deliver: Partial. On 2026-07-08 Q1 FY27 sales rose 8.2%, above plan, and FY27 sales guidance was raised to $1.759-1.831B, while total debt fell to $716.1M and net leverage to 3.48x from 3.87x. But FY26 reported on 2026-04-23 brought $79.2M of impairments and a GAAP loss per share of $39.08 (stockanalysis transcripts; stocktitan).
web_what_would_falsify: The 2026-10-08 Q2 FY27 report: if H1 FY27 adjusted EPS is not near 20% of the $3.25-3.75 guide, or Q2 gross margin falls beyond the guided tariff path, the H2-weighted recovery breaks. Also falsifying: FY27 sales below $1.759B, net leverage not falling toward about 3.2x, or China-tariff-exposed COGS not dropping below 20% (2026-04-23, 2026-07-08).
